headline: Replacing doors at Mark T. Sheehan High School for $22,707.84, plus New Wallingford High School update and cafeteria reports.
summary: The agenda covers financial reports, including $22,707.84 under the 2% Fund to replace doors at Mark T. Sheehan High School. It also includes cafeteria reports, a maintenance projects update, and an update on the new Wallingford High School.
